results.text:
# I’m excited to share that I’ve joined Probook to lead growth and build out the marketing organization. | Kate Blumberg · LinkedIn · 2026-06-23

**Kate Blumberg**: Director of Growth at Probook for 2 months with 14 years of total professional experience. Previous roles include Director of Demand Generation at BuildOps, Head of Growth at Middesk, and Director of Demand Generation at SafeGraph. Based in New York, New York, United States [US].

---

I’m excited to share that I’ve joined [Probook](https://linkedin.com/company/probook-ai) to lead growth and build out the marketing organization.

Over the last few years, I’ve found myself increasingly drawn to people who share a particular belief: that the trades are worth building a life around.

I’ve seen it in contractors who spend decades building great businesses. I’ve seen it in advocates like [Greg Crumpton](https://linkedin.com/in/crumptonskilledtrades) who work tirelessly to elevate the industry. And I’ve seen it in founders who could apply their talents anywhere but choose to invest them back into the trades.

That’s what stood out to me about [Probook](https://linkedin.com/company/probook-ai). Two of the founders grew up in the trades. They went on to become exceptional technologists, but instead of moving on from the industry, they chose to build for it.

The more time I spend around the trades, the more convinced I become that something special happens when talented people continue reinvesting their skills, experience, and ambition back into the industry that shaped them.

Today, [Probook](https://linkedin.com/company/probook-ai) is announcing $40M in funding led by Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia. To me, the announcement isn’t just about the capital. It’s another signal that some of the most ambitious founders, operators, technologists, and investors see what so many people in the industry already know: the trades are full of opportunity.

I’m incredibly excited to join the team and help build what’s next.

# When I joined Probook, a lot of people in my network asked me the same question: why? Why leave a comfortable seat to bet on a company in an industry most people … | Aaron Churba · LinkedIn · 2026-06-23

**Aaron Churba**: Director of Sales & Development at Probook for 5 months with 10 years 2 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Advisor at Bite, Director of Sales at Bite, and Sales at Techvera. Based in New York City Metropolitan Area [US].

---

When I joined [Probook](https://linkedin.com/company/probook-ai), a lot of people in my network asked me the same question: why? Why leave a comfortable seat to bet on a company in an industry most people overlook? So let me actually answer that.

The product was flying off the shelves. I'm not exaggerating. The fit was there from day one. It was the kind of product market fit you spend a whole career hoping to feel just once. The home services industry had never seen anything like this. These are the people who fix our homes and show up when something breaks; unsung heroes. And for the first time, they had software built like they actually mattered. The results spoke for themselves: a 29% average revenue lift per office FTE, more than 58,000 customer interactions handled autonomously every single day, and 82% of those interactions handled end to end.

That being said, excited to announce that [Probook](https://linkedin.com/company/probook-ai) has raised $40m, led by [Andreessen Horowitz](https://linkedin.com/company/a16z) & [Sequoia Capital](https://linkedin.com/company/sequoia).

But here's the part I'm proudest of, and it has nothing to do with a number on a term sheet.

It's the team. We've nearly tripled our GTM function since I came on board, and every single person we've added has raised the bar for everyone around them. I've watched people get promoted.
